children.text: What is a business line of credit?

A business line of credit is a type of business loan that gives you access to funding when you want it, up to your credit limit. Unlike traditional one-time loans, a Bluevine Line of Credit is “revolving credit,” meaning your available credit replenishes as you make repayments, so you can draw additional funds without having to fully re-apply. Though, all draws are subject to review and approval.

styles.transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out, border-radius 0.15s

children.text: How is a line of credit different from a small business loan?
A line of credit for business offers flexibility by allowing businesses to draw funds as needed, while a small business loan provides a lump sum of money with fixed repayment terms.

styles.transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out, border-radius 0.15s

children.text: How does a Bluevine Line of Credit work?

Once approved for a credit line, you can request funds directly from your Bluevine dashboard. We’ll deposit funds in your account as soon as a few hours, pending review and approval. Depending on which you qualified for, we’ll automatically debit your account for weekly or monthly repayments. As you pay off your balance, the amount of available credit you can request automatically replenishes.

styles.transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out, border-radius 0.15s

children.text: How can I get a line of credit through Bluevine?
You can . We’ll ask you for some basic information about you and your business. Once your application is submitted, you could get a decision in as little as five minutes.
apply for a Bluevine Line of Credit on our website
Just make sure you meet these minimum qualifications:
In good standing with your Secretary of State
Business is operating or incorporated in an eligible U.S. state
Ineligible states include: Nevada, North Dakota, South Dakota, U.S. territories
An active or statements from the last 3 months (a connected account makes it faster and easier to confirm your information).
It’s even easier to apply for a line of credit if you already have a .

styles.transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out, border-radius 0.15s

children.text: What businesses are eligible for a line of credit?
You can apply for a Bluevine Line of Credit as long as your business meets the minimum qualifications and does not operate in one of the following ineligible industries or states:
Other controlled substances (including medicinal marijuana, marijuana, cannabis, and hemp) and paraphernalia
Financial Institutions and lenders (including insurance, penny auction companies, and cryptocurrency)

styles.transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out, border-radius 0.15s

children.text: What documents are needed to apply for a business line of credit?
Typical documents include business bank statements, proof of revenue, and identification. Bluevine’s streamlined application process outlines specific requirements for applicants.

styles.transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out, border-radius 0.15s

children.text: Can I open a Bluevine Business Checking account with my line of credit?

Yes! If approved, your Bluevine Line of Credit comes with a complimentary , which you'll be able to set up during onboarding. This allows you to conveniently manage your business checking account and line of credit from one easy-to-use dashboard. Plus, you can instantly access approved draws from your line of credit in your business checking account.
You can also choose to open a Bluevine Business Checking account before you apply for a line of credit, which is the only way to be considered for all three available repayment plans.

styles.transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out, border-radius 0.15s

children.text: How do I qualify for a Bluevine Line of Credit?

To qualify for a Bluevine Line of Credit, your eligible business must be a corporation or LLC in business 12+ months, with no bankruptcies on file, and in good standing with your Secretary of State. Your business must also earn $10,000 in monthly revenue––or $120,000 annually––and you must have a 625+ personal FICO credit score. It’s easier to apply for a line of credit if you already have a

We’ll verify your information when you apply and each month after to ensure you remain eligible. The fastest way to do this is to connect your external bank account. If you don’t, you’ll need to manually upload bank statements from the last three months.

If you are a sole proprietorship, you cannot qualify for a Bluevine Line of Credit. However, sole proprietorships with a Bluevine Business Checking account may be able to apply for a line of credit through the Business Financing Center in their dashboard.

styles.transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out, border-radius 0.15s

children.text: Does applying for a Bluevine Line of Credit affect my credit score?

While applying and reviewing an offer will not impact your personal credit score, accepting an offer may result in a hard inquiry. Further, if you default on a Bluevine Line of Credit you may be subject to negative business reporting and personal credit reporting in your role as guarantor.

children.text: How quickly can I access funds with Bluevine’s line of credit?
Bluevine offers fast business funding, with approved businesses typically able to access funds within 24 hours of approval.

children.text: How can I use my Bluevine Line of Credit to grow my business?
A business line of credit provides small businesses with the flexibility to manage cash flow, cover unexpected expenses, or invest in growth opportunities without committing to a long-term loan.

children.text: Can I use a line of credit for seasonal business needs?
Absolutely. A revolving credit line is ideal for managing seasonal cash flow needs, allowing businesses to borrow when income fluctuates.
